data.one_liner: Plugin for reading QR codes and barcodes using Mobile Vision APIs.
data.what_it_does: Reads QR codes and barcodes using Android and iOS native APIs via Firebase's MLKit/Mobile Vision. It pipes camera images to the barcode detection API while outputting a preview image onto a Flutter texture.
use_when: You need to scan QR codes or barcodes inside a Flutter widget
You want a camera preview combined with real-time barcode scanning
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose camera plugin without barcode scanning
You are using a very old version of iOS below 15.5 and cannot upgrade
strengths: Includes a ready-to-use widget that performs necessary camera output transformations
Supports multiple barcode formats including QR, Aztec, Code 128, and PDF417
weaknesses: Requires proper constrained sizing (like a SizedBox or Container) for the camera preview
Flash toggling and navigation handling have some known limitations documented in the README
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring compatible iOS version (15.5+) and handling native Android/iOS camera permissions.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Often preferred for active maintenance, multi-platform support, and easier configuration for barcode scanning.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Directly uses Google ML Kit without being tied to a specific camera preview widget implementation.

alternatives.name: qr_code_scanner_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides another alternative specifically focused on QR code and barcode scanning widgets.
